approval.authority: Montri, owner instruction in this conversation

precedence: Complete standalone LDS0.9.6 normative and exact assets for adopted0.9.6 work
Separate applicable product Add-on binds the exact current base
Historical packages apply only to explicitly pinned historical work

sourceRules.COLOR-01: Exact production CSS or exact class/LUT records in color-srgb-09 only. New literals are not allowed by visual approximation.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-02: Every sequential family has three explicit anchors at indices0/20/40, with a visibly distinct middle hue. Use exact approved41-sample theme LUTs; classes3/5/7/9 at round(i*40/(n-1)); never interpolate at runtime.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-03: Theme-specific approved LUTs replace the historical dark-anchor formula and temporary mid-to-high restriction. Preserve full ranges in both themes.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-04: Every delivered analytical sample must avoid the applicable earth and violet windows; pink is allowed. Domain, unit and redundant cues remain mandatory.
sourceRules.DATAVIZ-05: Stable 10 IDs and cues; exact unchanged light values plus approved dark soft/vivid/ink. Deprecated v5 aliases prohibited.
sourceRules.EVID-05: Six value states: measured, measured_zero, no_data, out_of_scope, suppressed, not_yet; finite nonzero, zero, or null respectively.
sourceRules.SOCIALFMT-01: Full inherited sidecar contract admits square1080x1080 and OG1200x630 using the new schema; creative hash and dimensions required.
sourceRules.GOV-01/RELEASE-01: This owner-approved distribution is unsigned. An artifact may pin this exact channel and report scoped checks, but MUST NOT fabricate or inherit a signed 0.9.5 receipt or call itself fully conformant from package verification.

analytical.domainAndThresholds: consumer supplied; never silently normalized or clamped
analytical.outlierPolicy: consumer must declare reject, extend with approved scale, or explicit end-bin; never silently clamp
analytical.divergingMidpoint: must be meaningful and named; no equal-brightness arm claim

sequentialAnchors.middleHue: distinct from the end hue, never merely its lighter tint
sequentialAnchors.lightness: strictly decreasing in light; strictly increasing in dark
sequentialAnchors.constructionOnly: two OKLab segments through the three approved anchors; consumers use exact LUT samples
sequentialAnchors.notDiverging: The middle colour is a perceptual turn, not zero, a balance point or a second data direction.

categorical.fillSeparation: >=1px border.default or ink outline; do not imply all light fills meet3:1

brand.ijjiIdentity: ground.mist for light; #59C7E8 to #3BD3CB for dark. Retired warm product aliases must not be used as identity.

verificationBounds: Package parity and analytical math are automated.
Rendering, actual surface contrast, native Thai copy, source truth, threshold semantics, CVD/grayscale usability and each output format require artifact review.
No claim of signed0.9.6 release, complete conformance, universal platform enforcement or team installation.
Inherited open governance/product-icon/motif/signing follow-ups remain open unless specifically resolved here.
